original_test_intent: Validate recovery from ten deliberate AC removals while CPU, memory and storage stress has run for five minutes before each drop.

original_procedure_criteria.procedure: Stress CPU/DIMM/HDD for five minutes, remove and reconnect AC, and repeat ten times.
original_procedure_criteria.criteria: Normal recovery, expected AC-loss log and no device loss.

historical_reviews.v3: IMPROVED MANUAL ONLY with exact AC waveform, storage target, cycle evidence and no-hidden-retry requirements.

v3_1_conclusion.manual_test_activity: Authorized operator or approved power fixture performs AC removal; existing project stress/cycle tools may collect evidence.

master_vs_project_parameters.master_default: Ten cycles; five minutes of CPU/DIMM/HDD stress before each AC removal.
master_vs_project_parameters.project_inputs: Stress package/profile, safe storage target, AC waveform/dwell, boot readiness, expected events and approved override.
master_vs_project_parameters.coverage_difference: Changes to stress composition, five-minute pre-drop load or ten cycles are explicit gaps.

original_method: The physical AC-drop sequence and ten-cycle count are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use the approved project cycle controller and existing stress profile if they can synchronize five-minute load, AC waveform and per-cycle recovery evidence.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Target power architecture and protected stress targets.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Project power-cycle SOP, platform AC specification and approved stress-tool documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Formalizes timing and evidence; does not replace AC removal with reboot.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: All three stress domains and all ten cycles remain required.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Profiles, targets, waveform, readiness and stops.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Live power handling and storage writes are high risk.

missing_inputs: Safe storage target and stress profile
safety_boundaries: No manual live connector handling outside approved procedure
No hidden retry, credential exposure or log clearing
expected_evidence: Per-cycle five-minute stress interval and AC timestamps
no_automatic_retry: A failed AC cycle remains failed; no extra cycle without approval.
review_improvement: KEEP: V3 already preserved the destructive timing intent and converted vague recovery language into target-specific evidence and safety gates.
